identified_issues: Violation of Storage Cluster Security & Operations Standard Section 8.4 operational prerequisites
Execution of low-level block stream ingestion on non-quiescent node with 14 active client handles
Failure of defensive fail-closed controls allowing CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM execution despite drain failure and unverified dirty write buffers
evidence: Node Supervisor Drain Log recorded drain timeout at 02:00:08.410Z with 14 client connections pinned by open write transactions, aborting drain and leaving node non-quiescent
Block Synchronization Execution Log at 02:00:15.050Z explicitly confirmed '14 active client handles; dirty buffers unverified' immediately prior to command execution
CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM proceeded at 02:00:15.100Z despite non-zero client handles and unquiesced state, directly risking journal overwrite and volume corruption
recommended_action: Immediately quarantine STOR_NODE_06 to prevent further I/O, dismount the affected storage volume, and execute offline journal and filesystem integrity checks against volume snapshots. Update the automation orchestration tooling and supervisor daemon to strictly fail-closed by enforcing programmatic pre-execution guards that abort CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM if active client handles exceed zero or if node quiescence verification fails.
